column1: # ci-matrix.tsv — every REAL e2e suite, and how its client is provided.
#   ubuntu-latest   the client is installed with a GitHub Action (or is already
#                   on the runner). ONE job per protocol, so the install steps
#                   are `if:`-guarded and only the needed toolchain is set up.
#                   This is the default and covers every application-level
#                   ONLY for the distro package managers. `apk` is Alpine's
#                   package manager and does not exist on Ubuntu; `apt`/`dnf`
#                   on Ubuntu would test THIS image's package handling against
#                   a foreign distro's repository, which is the wrong subject.
#                   These three genuinely require the distro userland they are
#                   testing, so they keep a job container.
# --- application-level clients: installed with actions on ubuntu-latest ---

column4: conan via pip (installed in the job)
Apache Ivy (jar fetched in the job) on actions/setup-java
jenkins-plugin-cli (jar fetched in the job) + setup-java

column1: # --- distro package managers: these NEED their own userland ---

column4: apt tests THIS distro's archive layout
dnf tests THIS distro's repomd metadata

column1: # --- protocols whose client is plain HTTP by nature ---

column4: curl IS the client (raw HTTP cache semantics)
wget speaks the OCI /v2 protocol (no docker daemon needed)
